subject: FinAnchor DPA: SCCs & evidence triage for signature routing
messages:

Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New customer onboarding — DPA, SCCs, SOC2 evidence request

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the demo last week — FinAnchor is excited to proceed. Our procurement and privacy teams have a short checklist to close before we can cut PO/execute:

- Our standard DPA with SCCs executed, with any redlines tracked.
- SOC 2 Type II report (latest) and SIG/CAIQ answers for the Redwoods service.
- Confirmation of subprocessors and a data deletion timeline for end-of-contract.

I've attached our initial SCC matrix (FinAnchor_SCCs_v2.docx) and marked a couple of HIPAA notes (we're a fintech that occasionally handles PHI). Can you please confirm target turnaround for execution? We're hoping to sign within 30 days.

Also include any evidence that will be uploaded to our procurement portal (e.g., SOC2 link, certificate). Happy to route legal-specific items to our counsel (cc'd).

Best,
Carmen
Carmen Soto
Head of Procurement — FinAnchor

Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New customer onboarding — DPA, SCCs, SOC2 evidence request

Hi Carmen — thanks for the checklist and for the clear timeline. High level plan:

1) I'll attach our annotated DPA for your team to review (see attached: DPA_redlines_annotated.pdf).
2) Marcus (Legal) will review SCC-specific asks and confirm any non-standard data flow items.
3) Priyom (Solutions/Engineering) will gather SOC 2 link and CAIQ/SIG export; we can upload to your portal or share a secure Drive link.
4) We'll confirm subprocessor list and provide a deletion SLA statement for contract language.

Goal: get to an agreed DPA redline within ~10 business days, route for signature via DocuSign if acceptable. Two items to flag for rapid alignment: (a) retention & deletion timing (FinAnchor vs Redwood default), and (b) any HIPAA-specific obligations — we typically support BAAs but need explicit scope.

Marcus — can you take the SCCs and HIPAA notes and call out any clauses we should expect to negotiate?

Carmen — attaching our redlines now; please highlight any must-have edits in your return.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Carmen Soto <carmen.soto@financhor.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 14:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New customer onboarding — DPA, SCCs, SOC2 evidence request

Naomi / Carmen — quick legal triage below after an initial pass on the SCC matrix and the redlines: 

- Data deletion: FinAnchor's request for a 30-day deletion window post-contract is more aggressive than our standard 90 days. Recommend we offer a 45-day accelerated deletion for this FinAnchor deal if they accept additional audit logs for export.
- Subprocessors: we should include our standard subprocessor appendix and offer a 30-day notice clause for new subprocessors; push back on any unilateral right to object without remediation path.
- HIPAA: if FinAnchor needs HIPAA BAA terms, we can provide a limited BAA addendum for the SaaS interactions that clearly call out responsibilities and permitted PHI processing. We should confirm expected categories of PHI and whether FinAnchor is contracting as a BA or a hybrid regulated client.

I'll prepare marked language suggestions for the DPA and a short exec summary if they push for the 30-day sign target.

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference

From: Carmen Soto <carmen.soto@financhor.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@financhor.com, PrivacyOps <privacy@financhor.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New customer onboarding — DPA, SCCs, SOC2 evidence request

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the quick triage. A few clarifications from our side:

- Deletion window: FinAnchor policy requires 30 days. We can accept a short transition export window (we don't want extended retention at all).
- Subprocessors: our procurement team will accept your standard appendix as long as there's a 14-day objection window.
- HIPAA: we are acting as BA for a subset of customers; we'd need a BAA addendum. Can Redwood provide the BAA template?

I've attached our annotated DPA with the clauses our legal team cannot accept highlighted in yellow. If we can get to an execution path that commits to 30-day deletion and a BAA addendum, procurement can prioritize the PO (we're on a fast track with internal approvals).

-Carmen
--- attachment: FinAnchor_DPA_comments_annotated.pdf (pdf) ---

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Carmen Soto <carmen.soto@financhor.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New customer onboarding — DPA, SCCs, SOC2 evidence request

Carmen — thanks for the quick turnaround and for flagging the non-starters. Next steps and routing: 

1) Marcus will finalize language for the 30-day deletion SLA and the BAA addendum by EOD tomorrow.
2) Priyom will upload the latest SOC 2 Type II report, CAIQ export, and SIG summary to a secure Drive and share the link to your portal by tomorrow morning.
3) If FinAnchor can provisionally accept the 30-day deletion language and the standard subprocessor appendix (with the 14-day objection window), we'll route the DPA for signature via DocuSign.

DocuSign routing plan: Naomi -> Marcus (legal sign-off) -> Priyom (ops confirmation) -> FinAnchor primary signer (Carmen). I will send the DocuSign envelope once legal approves. Expect the DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/abcd-1234-financhor

I'll also create a short mutual action plan in HubSpot and tag the deal (FINA-2027-045). Priyom / Grace — looping you to prepare the evidence bundle and procurement checklist.

Action items summarized:
- Marcus: finalize redline language (deletion SLA & BAA)
- Priyom: evidence upload + ops note on retention flow
- Naomi: prepare DocuSign envelope & HubSpot MAP

Let's aim to have the envelope ready for signature by end of week so FinAnchor can meet their procurement window.

Best,
Naomi
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
